name: QRCodeCrafter WebMCP Context
description: Machine-consumable context for QRCodeCrafter interactive components and forms.

dynamicQr.description: Private editable HTTPS redirects with privacy-preserving aggregate analytics enabled in production.

campaign.execution: Sequential same-origin POST requests to /api/dynamic-qr with no automatic retry
campaign.privacy: Management capabilities exist only in the returned private manifest or downloaded browser-local ZIP and are never stored in browser storage
campaign.assets: The visible workflow generates SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF, or EPS files locally; runtime agents call generate_qr for each returned redirectUrl

patch.tokenRotation: When rotateToken is true, managementToken and managementUrl are returned once and the previous token is invalidated.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the redirect. The printed QR code will return 404 and deletion cannot be undone.

errors.503: storage unavailable or active-record capacity reached

rateLimits.guidance: Throttle batch jobs, prefer SVG for high-volume tests, and honor Retry-After before retrying 429 or 503 responses.

bulk.guidance: Use rows as CSV text or row objects with value and optional filename. Prefer SVG for large batches; split PDF, JPG, or WebP batches when rate-limit headers require it.

verifiedGeneration.assetReturnPolicy: Asset bytes are returned only when the final file decodes to the requested payload. Decode failures return the full receipt without data or dataUrl.
verifiedGeneration.limitation: Uses one jsQR software decoder and rendering pipeline. It is not ISO/IEC 15415 verification, physical print testing, device, printer, accessibility, malware, or security certification.

verification.liveSmokeCommand: npm run test:live-qr -- --base-url https://qrcodecrafter.com --method POST --discovery-source remote --payload-source recipes
verification.scanPayloadComparison: Exact decoded payload match, allowing only line-ending normalization and trailing whitespace trimming for decoder compatibility.

agentGuidance.preferredWorkflow: Prefer WebMCP runtime or declarative results for compact metadata. Use downloadUrl when present for no-logo public HTTP(S) URL assets, or POST JSON to the generateQrEndpoint when an agent explicitly needs base64 data/dataUrl bytes.
agentGuidance.runtimeTool: The live site registers generate_qr, generate_verified_qr, generate_bulk_qr, create_dynamic_qr, create_dynamic_qr_campaign, and manage_dynamic_qr through document.modelContext.registerTool when available, with navigator.modelContext fallback. Server-rendered forms expose matching toolname and tooldescription attributes before client islands hydrate.
agentGuidance.payloadWarning: Static QR codes cannot be changed after printing unless the encoded URL is a redirect that the user controls.
agentGuidance.rateLimit: QR generation uses cost-weighted soft limits per client. SVG is cheapest; raster, PDF, larger size, and logo jobs consume more budget. Honor Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Remaining on 429 and 503 responses.
agentGuidance.llmsTxt: Read https://qrcodecrafter.com/llms.txt for a concise Markdown index of agent interfaces, core QR tools, payment generators, content guides, and optional policies.

tools.name: generate_qr
tools.title: Generate QR code
tools.description: Generate a static QR code file from a supplied payload. Supports URL, Wi-Fi, text, contact, event, location, app, social, and payment QR assets including VietQR.

value.description: Exact QR payload to encode, such as an HTTPS URL, WIFI payload, vCard, calendar event, payment URI, or text.

logo.description: Optional PNG, JPG, or WebP data URL for a centered logo.

execute.response: Direct API JSON includes base64 data/dataUrl plus downloadUrl when safe. Runtime WebMCP and HTML JSON-LD fallbacks return compact metadata, byteLength, dimensions, suggestedFilename, and download instructions without raw asset bytes.

tools.name: generate_verified_qr
tools.title: Generate and verify QR code
tools.description: Generate a static QR asset, structurally review its payload, assess quiet zone and contrast settings, decode the final file, compare payload hashes, and return a bounded evidence-linked receipt.

value.description: Exact QR payload to generate, structurally review, decode, and hash-compare.

logo.description: Optional PNG, JPG, or WebP data URL for a centered logo.

execute.response: Direct JSON includes asset bytes only when final-file decoding matches the requested payload. Decode failures return HTTP 422 with the full receipt and no data or dataUrl. Runtime WebMCP and HTML JSON-LD fallbacks omit raw asset bytes while retaining hashes, checks, cautions, evidence links, and download instructions.

tools.name: generate_bulk_qr
tools.title: Generate bulk QR ZIP
tools.description: Generate a ZIP archive of up to 50 static QR code files from CSV or row objects for labels, classrooms, packaging, menus, and agent batch workflows.

value.description: Exact QR payload for this file.

filename.description: Optional filename stem for this generated QR file.

oneOf.description: CSV rows such as filename,value or value,filename.

rows.description: Rows to include in the ZIP archive. Use up to 50 rows per request.

execute.response: ZIP archive with QR files plus manifest.csv and manifest.json, or JSON metadata with base64 ZIP data when application/json is requested

tools.name: create_dynamic_qr
tools.title: Create dynamic QR redirect
tools.description: Create an editable public HTTPS redirect and return its stable QR URL plus a one-time private management capability.

execute.response: Returns the stable redirect URL, record, ETag, and one-time management token and URL. Store the capability securely.

tools.name: manage_dynamic_qr
tools.title: Manage dynamic QR redirect
tools.description: Read, update, pause, resume, rotate, or permanently delete a dynamic QR redirect with a private capability. Changes fetch the current ETag first.

execute.method: GET then optional PATCH or DELETE
execute.response: Returns the record and ETag. Rotation returns a replacement capability once and immediately invalidates the previous token. Delete returns 204 and permanently disables the printed QR URL.

tools.name: create_qr_vault
tools.title: Create dynamic QR vault
tools.description: Create a private capability-managed vault for up to 50 dynamic QR redirects. The management token is returned only on creation. Empty vaults expire after six hours; adding a QR makes the project durable.

execute.response: Returns the public vault, emptyExpiresAt lifecycle deadline, vault ETag, and the one-time private vault management token and URL. No child credentials or internal storage fields are exposed.

tools.name: manage_qr_vault
tools.title: Manage dynamic QR vault
tools.description: Read aggregate analytics, rename, delete, create, update, pause, resume, or delete vault-owned dynamic QR records with one private capability. Every mutation first fetches the current ETag.

update_qr: one of destination, label, folder, tags

execute.method: GET, or GET then action-dependent POST, PATCH, or DELETE
execute.response: Returns only public vault/child fields, privacy-preserving aggregate scan analytics, and current validators. Vault and child ETags are distinct. The management token is never echoed by manage actions.

tools.name: create_dynamic_qr_campaign
tools.title: Create dynamic QR campaign
tools.description: Sequentially create up to five editable HTTPS redirects and return a private manifest with explicit partial failures and one-time management capabilities.

execute.method: Up to five sequential POST requests
execute.response: Private created/failed manifest with stable redirect URLs and one-time management capabilities. Call generate_qr for each created redirectUrl when files are required.
